product.title: Chicago City Sights Helicopter Tour

description.text: Discover Chicago's landmarks from the air on a daytime helicopter tour with bird's-eye views of Willis Tower, Millennium Park, and the Lake Michigan shoreline. Your pilot points out architectural icons and lakefront parks during a focused aerial loop over the city center. The open-cockpit or wide-window seating maximizes photo opportunities in clear weather. This premium outing suits visitors who want a thrilling complement to river and walking tours.

highlights: Daytime helicopter tour over downtown Chicago
Aerial views of Willis Tower and Millennium Park
Lake Michigan and Navy Pier shoreline perspectives

start.description: Arrive at the Chicago heliport confirmed on your voucher for check-in and safety briefing.

end.description: Return to the heliport terminal after the flight lands.
